about: E54 glass, the plan G1 and G5 in one cut: the curtain cut and the pure helpers it reads (the convex-polygon helpers, the field, the turn affine math, the voice tile settle, the turns and the strip constants) move out of glass.mjs into glass-geometry.mjs. One cut, not two, because split.mjs refuses a target that already exists; it runs after the behaviour commits on claude/e54-behaviour, through 699d5bab (G3, G4: the partitions take the page as an argument and give their writes back; G4b: settleVoice takes its wall), which E54 day cherry-picks first: at 32f5093f the cut reads PIN, the rails and avLift, a read of the facade split.mjs refuses. railBox, resolveAcc and accProbe read the page and stay; centreOrder stands among the turn helpers and is not on the plan F6 list, so it stays. Run: node tools/e54/split.mjs --manifest tools/e54/glass.json, then node tools/e54/repoint.mjs --manifest tools/e54/glass.json.
facadeNote: E54 (the plan G1, G5): the curtain cut and the pure helpers it reads live in glass-geometry.mjs, re-exported here; this file keeps the page: measuring it, painting, the turn and the lifecycle.

header: The curtain cut, pure (E54, the plan G1 and G5): what the glass is cut into for a screen and the blocks on it,
from arguments alone - the convex-polygon helpers, the slope field, the column and band cutters, the partitions
(`windowShapes`, `stackShapes`, `deskShapes`, `curtainShapes`, `meetBands`), the voice tile settle, the turns
and the affine math of the turn. Moved out of glass.mjs, which re-exports what it exported, measures the page for
the cut (`stackPage`, `deskPage`, `curtainPage`) and writes what the cut gives back (`writeCut`). It reads no page
and no state of glass.mjs: R4805.
Where a block stands on the curtain cut (E54, the plan G5): the voice tile settled at its wall and under its
floor (`settleVoice`, with the VOICE_* measures) and the turn a block takes with its column (`blockTurns`). Moved
out of glass.mjs with the cut (glass-geometry.mjs, which reads both); a file of its own so that each function
still ends where it ended in glass.mjs - a test that cuts a function reads to the next one (tests-kit.mjs

repoint.about: tools/e54/repoint.mjs part for this cut (sheet.json repoint says what each field is).
